description: Machine-readable reference data for the EA FC 26 Pro Clubs Builder: archetypes, attributes, playstyles and specializations. Generated directly from the builder's source data.

requirements: Height <= 182cm for male players, <= 162cm for female players
Height >= 185cm for male players, >= 165cm for female players
Default type when neither Explosive nor Lengthy requirements are met

specializationPerks.perkDescription: Do a Pass and Go in the attacking half for a short boost to Acceleration, Ball Control, Balance
Shoot after entering the box from the wing for a boost to Finishing, Curve, Shot Power
Give a short boost to Composure, Finishing, Ball Control to your pass target in opponents box
Shoot with your back to goal in the box gain a short boost to Shot Power, Finishing, and Balance
Win the ball in the attacking third to gain a short boost to Vision, Short Passing and Curve
Take a first timed shot in the box to gain a short boost to Shot Power, Balance, Composure
Get a Line-breaking pass in the attacking third for a boost to Dribbling, Balance, and Composure
With back to goal pass in attacking third for a short boost to Finishing, Balance, and Composure
At full sprint, shoot in opponent's half for a boost to Shot Power, Strength, and Aggression
First time Driven Pass in the defensive half for a boost to Short Passing, Vision, Long Passing
Successful Stand Tackle in the defensive half for a boost to Aggression, Strength, Acceleration
Team loses ball while you in middle third get a boost to Acceleration, Standing Tackle, Strength
Successful Stand Tackle in the defensive half for a short boost to Short Passing, Long Passing, Vision
Enter the opponents box from the middle for a short boost to Finishing, Composure, Vision
Successful Hard Stand Tackle in defensive half for a short boost to Acceleration, Reactions, Stamina
Give a boost to Finishing, Balance, Ball Control to your through pass target in opponents half
Cross from the attacking wings for a short boost to Curve, Long Passing, Crossing
Dribble into the box from the middle and shoot for a boost to Finishing, Shot Power, Reactions
Skill move past an opponent on the attacking wing to boost Agility, Acceleration, Sprint Speed
Skill move past an opponent in the attacking half to boost Short Passing, Curve, Composure
Skill move past an opponent in the attacking third to boost Curve, Finishing, Shot Power
Intercept ball in defensive half for a short boost to Balance, Curve, Short Passing
Dribble into the attacking third for a short boost to Ball Control, Composure, Dribbling
Be last player in defensive half for a boost to Acceleration, Sliding Tackle, Standing Tackle
Physical Tackle in defensive third for a short boost to Strength, Vision, Aggression
Successful Slide Tackle in middle third for a short boost to Composure, Slide Tackle, Aggression
Be last player in defensive half for a boost to Def Awareness, Balance, Interceptions
Enter the opponents box from the middle for a short boost to Finishing, Shot Power, Reactions
Do a Pass and Go in the middle third for a short boost to Dribbling, Sprint Speed, Agility
Team loses ball while you in middle third get a boost to Strength, Aggression, Standing Tackle
Do a Pass and Go in defensive half for a short boost to Balance, Acceleration, Reactions
Knock-on past an opponent in attacking wing for a boost to Acceleration, Agility, Sprint Speed
Team loses ball while you in defensive wing get a boost to Balance, Sprint Speed, Ball Control

attributes.name: Acceleration
attributes.description: Affects how quickly you can reach your top speed

attributes.name: Sprint Speed
attributes.description: Increases your top speed

attributes.name: Attack Positioning
attributes.description: Affects your positioning when your player is AI controlled

attributes.name: Finishing
attributes.description: Increases your chances of beating the keeper with shots inside the box

attributes.name: Shot Power
attributes.description: Shot power increases the velocity of all shot types and from any distance

attributes.name: Long Shots
attributes.description: Long Shots increase your chances of beating the keeper with shots outside the box

attributes.name: Volleys
attributes.description: Volleys raise your passing and shooting effectiveness when a ball is in the air

attributes.name: Penalties
attributes.description: Having a higher penalty attribute will make it easier to strike a PK cleanly.

attributes.name: Vision
attributes.description: Vision raises your ability to play accurate and intricate through ball passes

attributes.name: Crossing
attributes.description: Improves crossing accuracy

attributes.name: FK Accuracy
attributes.description: Increases your free kick accuracy

attributes.name: Short Passing
attributes.description: The better your short passing, the less likely it is that your player misplaces passes

attributes.name: Long Passing
attributes.description: Increases the accuracy of lobbed passes

attributes.name: Curve
attributes.description: Curve increases your ability to bend the path of the ball when shooting or passing

attributes.name: Agility
attributes.description: Agility determines how quickly you can change directions

attributes.name: Balance
attributes.description: Balance reduces your chances of stumbling & falling when challenged by an opponent

attributes.name: Reactions
attributes.description: Reaction speed improves your ability to perform most on-the-ball actions

attributes.name: Ball Control
attributes.description: This raises your control over the ball, such as when trapping or doing skill moves

attributes.name: Dribbling
attributes.description: Determines how close you keep the ball to your feet while dribbling

attributes.name: Composure
attributes.description: Helps you play to your full abilities when under pressure

attributes.name: Interceptions
attributes.description: This increases your range and control when intercepting your opponent's passes

attributes.name: Heading Accuracy
attributes.description: Increases your precision when passing or shooting with your head

attributes.name: Def Awareness
attributes.description: Increases your effectiveness when jockeying and when under AI control

attributes.name: Standing Tackle
attributes.description: Increases your standing tackling ability

attributes.name: Sliding Tackle
attributes.description: Increases your slide tackling ability

attributes.name: Jumping
attributes.description: Increases your effectiveness in all aspects of in-air play

attributes.name: Stamina
attributes.description: Increases your overall stamina

attributes.name: Strength
attributes.description: Strength raises your chance of winning physical duels, both on and off the ball

attributes.name: Aggression
attributes.description: Aggression raises your chance of success when performing risky tackles and blocks.

playstyles.name: finesse shot
playstyles.description: Performs finesse shots faster with additional curve and improved accuracy.

playstyles.name: Chip shot
playstyles.description: Performs chip shots faster and with greater accuracy.

playstyles.name: power shot
playstyles.description: Performs power shots faster and with increased speed.

playstyles.name: dead ball
playstyles.description: Set pieces are delivered with increased speed, curve, and accuracy. Ball trajectory preview line is longer.

playstyles.name: precision header
playstyles.description: Performs headers with increased accuracy and power.

playstyles.name: acrobatic
playstyles.description: Performs volleys with improved accuracy and has access to acrobatic volley animations.

playstyles.name: low driven shot
playstyles.description: Enhances a player's ability to execute low driven shots with increased accuracy, faster ball travel, and quicker shot execution.

playstyles.name: game changer
playstyles.description: Fancy and Trivela shots are performed with improved accuracy.

playstyles.name: incisive pass
playstyles.description: Through passes are more accurate, Swerve Passes are delivered with more curve, and Precision Passes travel faster to the destination.

playstyles.name: pinged pass
playstyles.description: Passes travel faster along the ground without impacting the trapping difficulty of the receiver.

playstyles.name: long ball
playstyles.description: Lob and Lofted Through Passes are more accurate, travel faster, and are more difficult to intercept.

playstyles.name: tiki taka
playstyles.description: Executes difficult first-time Ground Passes with high accuracy, using backheels when contextually appropriate. Short distance Ground Passes are highly accurate.

playstyles.name: whipped pass
playstyles.description: All crosses are highly accurate, travel faster, and with more curve.

playstyles.name: inventive
playstyles.description: Fancy and Trivela passes are performed with improved accuracy.

playstyles.name: jockey
playstyles.description: Increased max speed of Sprint Jockey and improved transition speed from jockey to sprint.

playstyles.name: block
playstyles.description: Increased reach when performing blocks and improved ability to make a successful block.

playstyles.name: intercept
playstyles.description: Increased reach and improved chances of retaining possession of the ball when performing interceptions.

playstyles.name: anticipate
playstyles.description: Improved chances of standing tackle success and grants the ability to stop the ball directly at their feet when performing a standing tackle.

playstyles.name: slide tackling
playstyles.description: Grants the ability to stop the ball directly at their feet when performing a slide tackle.

playstyles.name: aerial fortress
playstyles.description: Performs higher jumps and has increased physical presence before and during defensive aerial duels.

playstyles.name: technical
playstyles.description: Reaches a higher speed when performing controlled sprint and performs wide turns while dribbling with more precision.

playstyles.name: rapid
playstyles.description: Reaches a higher sprint speed while dribbling and has reduced chance of an error when sprinting or performing knock-ons.

playstyles.name: first touch
playstyles.description: Has reduced error when trapping the ball and is able to transition to dribbling faster with greater control.

playstyles.name: trickster
playstyles.description: Grants the ability to perform unique flick Skill Moves.

playstyles.name: press proven
playstyles.description: Keeps close control of the ball while dribbling at jog speed and can shield the ball more effectively from stronger opponents.

playstyles.name: quick step
playstyles.description: Accelerates faster during Explosive Sprint.

playstyles.name: relentless
playstyles.description: Reduces fatigue loss during play and increases fatigue recovery during halftime.

playstyles.name: long throw
playstyles.description: Performs throw-ins with increased power to cover a greater distance.

playstyles.name: bruiser
playstyles.description: Greater strength when performing physical tackles.

playstyles.name: enforcer
playstyles.description: Performs dribble shoulder challenges and Shielding with increased effectiveness.

corrections: Third regular slot uses level 30 from current calculator, not level 20 from JSON metadata
Target Strength uses tier 3 before key-attribute discount
